build.name: cpucp
build.build_command: for chip in waipio fillmore palima netrani clarence; do make CHIPSET=$chip target_sign_v2_qti_test; done && rm -rf .git* readme.rst .omniscanignore docs/

build.name: cpuss_vm
build.build_command: export PATH=/pkg/qct/software/gnu/make/4.1/bin:$PATH && for soc in waipio fillmore netrani clarence; do make SOC_FAMILY=$soc internal_release external_release; done && rm -rf .git* README.md

step.params: python @tool_name sectools metabuild-secure-image --vouch-for --image-id QUPV3 AOP SHRM XBL-CONFIG UEFI XBL-RAM-DUMP CPUCP TZ QHEE TZ-DEVCFG MPSS ADSP CDSP CPUSYS-VM WPSS --outfile @out_file --chipset NETRANI --hash --signing-mode TEST --sign --flavor asic -vv --storage ufs
